C1222.title: SAMR Opens Investigation into Trip.com Group for Suspected Abuse of Market Dominance
C1222.summary: On January 14, 2026, Xinhua reported that the State Administration for Market Regulation had opened an investigation into Trip.com Group Co., Ltd. for suspected abuse of market dominance under China's Anti-Monopoly Law after a preliminary review. The announcement concerned the start of an investigation and did not state a finding of violation or a penalty.
